policies.title: Mongolia: ordinary passports exempt under ongoing bilateral or unilateral rules
policies.summary: The current Consular Department schedule expressly records these ordinary/all-passport visa exemptions, with the stated stay periods.
conditions: The source records nationality-specific stays: PH 21 days; HK 14; KZ, US, MO, BY, BR, AR, CL, EC, PE, PY and CO 90; the remaining listed nationalities 30 days.

This is an ordinary-passport visitor result. It excludes Ukraine’s official-invitation condition, diplomatic/official/service agreements, UN laissez-passer cases, work, residence, transit, extensions and admission decisions.
The Consular Department schedule identifies Colombia as ordinary passports only; other listed entries say all passports, but this candidate is limited to ordinary passports.

policies.title: Mongolia: temporary 2026 34-country tourist exemption
policies.summary: Mongolia’s Government and Immigration Agency currently exempt this 34-country cohort from tourist visa requirements for stays up to 30 days in 2026.
conditions: Valid only for tourism and up to 30 days, in the 2026 programme. It should not be carried forward after 31 December 2026 without a new official measure.
This temporary exemption does not establish work, residence, study, long stay, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, or case-specific admission rights.
Current Immigration material also lists these countries for border tourist-visa issuance; visa-free tourism is the easier applicable route during this programme.

policies.title: Mongolia: Republic of Korea temporary tourism exemption
policies.summary: The current Consular Department schedule records a 90-day all-passport visa exemption for Korean tourism through 31 December 2026.
conditions: Tourism purpose only, up to 90 days. The time limit is explicit and requires renewed confirmation after 31 December 2026.
It does not decide work, residence, study, diplomatic, official, service, transit, crew, special-document or individual admissibility treatment.

policies.title: Mongolia: Indian ordinary passport tourist visa at border without prior visa permit
policies.summary: The Immigration Agency’s current exhaustive border list names India among nationalities to which tourist visas may be issued at the international border without visa permit.
conditions: This is a tourist visa issued at the international border without a prior visa permit, so it is classified as visa on arrival rather than eVisa or visa-free.
The official eVisa country list also names India, but the border-issued tourist route is the easier applicable route for the baseline taxonomy.

It does not establish a visa-free right or govern work, residence, study, transit, crew, diplomatic/official/service, special-document, fee, port, duration, extension, security or individual-admissibility questions.

policies.title: Mongolia: named ordinary passports eligible for eVisa
policies.summary: The Immigration Agency’s current exhaustive eVisa-country list names these countries; after removing easier visa-free and Indian border-visa routes, their baseline visitor route is eVisa.
conditions: Apply electronically before travel through Mongolia’s official eVisa service; this is a visa, not an ETA or a visa on arrival.
The portal requires a passport/relevant substitute valid at least 180 days before intended travel; the eVisa is non-extendable and non-convertible.

Carry the eVisa copy and the passport used in the application. Border biometrics are mandatory; admission remains discretionary. The inviting person, accommodation provider or host entity must register the foreign national online within 48 hours after arrival.

This finding is limited to the named country list and ordinary visitor entry. It does not establish work, residence, study, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, alien-document, group-tour, invitation or port-specific rights.
The current eVisa portal contains a legacy non-navigable country-list section; this classification relies on the Immigration Agency’s current expressly titled eVisa eligibility list.

application.label: Mongolia electronic visa application
steps: Apply online through the official eVisa system.
Provide accurate application information and pay the non-refundable visa fee.
Carry the issued eVisa copy and the same passport to border control.
